title: Invertibility of the global finite dualizing comparison
statement: The finite dualizing etale comparison is an isomorphism under the prime inequality.

source.place: paragraphs 1--3, global comparison after affine-chart descent

proof.text: Identify the original finiteDualizingEtaleComparison with the published dualizingScalarMap by naturality of the adjunction Hom equivalence, without changing the coefficient-unit arrow. The dualizing construction supplies the bounded constructible finite-Tor source.

On each affine open choose the finite-type closed embedding in affine space. The open/closed mate normalization identifies the restricted coefficient map, up to isomorphisms, with the closed coefficient mate followed by the closed upper-shriek image of the affine-space dualizing map.

The closed descent theorem makes the actual counit-defined closed mate invertible. Apply the finite smooth dualizing scalar theorem to the affine-space structural projection: the finite quotient coefficients are annihilated by l^(m+1), and l is invertible on Spec k by l≠p. Thus both component arrows and their composite are isomorphisms.

Cancel the open scalar isomorphism and the object identification on each affine open. The jointly surjective affine-open family reflects isomorphisms of derived etale objects, proving the original comparison invertible.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs 1--3; affine-space smooth comparison, closed descent, and the explicit open/closed coefficient square
